title: Fig Asks for Help
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'ue' and 'aw'.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar crawling along a dusty beam inside an old wooden barn.
Fig the caterpillar spotting a small bug stuck fast in a blob of amber sap.
Close view of the thick, sticky amber sap holding the bug in place.
Fig the caterpillar straining to pull the stuck bug loose from the sap.
Fig the caterpillar pausing, out of breath, the bug still stuck.
Fig the caterpillar calling up towards Olive the owl perched above.
Olive the owl flying in through the open barn door.
Olive the owl and Fig the caterpillar both pulling the stuck bug together.
The small bug finally coming loose from the sap, sap stretching behind it.
Fig the caterpillar and Olive the owl smiling together in the barn.
